name: PR detail Overview shows the seeded Why & risk brief and a focus link opens the diff
description: From PR #482, the Overview tab renders the seeded brief (summary, a risk title, review-focus links) without any model call, the brief survives a reload, and clicking the review-focus link src/config.ts:11 lands on the Files changed tab with ?tab=diff&file=src%2Fconfig.ts and the file rendered. Read-only: Generate and Refresh are never clicked, so no key and no LLM are needed. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where PR #482 carries the seed brief (see e2e/README.md). The scroll and highlight of the focused line are not asserted here (the runner has no layout check); they are covered in DiffTab.test.tsx.
